worldcombat.skill.overdrive.summary: Plants its feet, lifts the instrument and strums three times straight forward: every strum rolls a charged wall of sound down one lane, and each foe in the lane takes a heavy hit, is knocked back, and may be stunned into paralysis. With Echo on, a heavier late echo returns after the third strum.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.0: Hit three times down one line to pin foes standing in a row
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.1: Gamble on paralysis with charged sound
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.2: Knock a foe at the end of the lane back through cover
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.use.3: Turn on Echo to crack one tough target
Planted in place, it strums three times: each pushes a lane toward the target, settling about %1$s special damage on every foe in it and rolling a %2$s paralysis, hitting at most %3$s foes per strum; the target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The lane runs %1$s blocks long and %2$s blocks to each side, and the strums are %3$s apart; it ignores cover and the ground, shaking exactly the lane it draws.

Each strum shoves those in the lane up to %1$s blocks along it; a target that is stunned is paralysed for %2$s, moving at half speed with a 25%% chance to fail each attempt, and Electric types cannot be paralysed.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.echo.on: Echo on: about 1.1 s after the third strum a late echo returns for %1$s × power, sweeping the same lane again with the same shove and another paralysis roll; each strum is about ×0.82 power with +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.echo.off: Echo off: three tight strums, cast and cooled down faster, to get in and out quickly.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.timing: Reaches %1$s blocks down a lane; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.growth.0: At level %1$s each strum rises to %2$s, the lane reaches %3$s blocks, and the paralysis chance rises to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.preference.e: On: a heavier late echo returns after the third strum (each strum about ×0.82 power, the total spread over more hits), one more paralysis roll, cooldown +8 ticks, to gamble on the status or crack a tough target. Off: three tight strums, cast and cooled down faster, to get in and out quickly.
worldcombat.skill.overdrive.preference.a: The companion only considers Overdrive when a threat is this close; lower it to strum only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible foes must stand in the lane direction before it fires; raise it to strum only into a row and save PP, set it to 1 to strum at a single target.
